title: Optimize placeholder index parsing
rationale: Execution paths parsed placeholders such as $1 with p.replace("$", "").parse(), allocating a temporary String for each parameter evaluation. A shared strip_prefix-based helper parses the index without allocation and keeps existing invalid-placeholder behavior.
steps: Use the helper in expression evaluation and FTS indexed MATCH scanning
Add a focused unit test for placeholder parsing
Add SQL integration coverage for WHERE id = $1 and MATCH(body) AGAINST($1)
expected_impact: Avoids temporary String allocation in parameterized expression and FTS query evaluation paths.
